strings.about_duaa_text: May Allah accept this humble effort purely for His sake, forgive our shortcomings, and make it a source of light and blessing for the entire Ummah.
strings.about_pillar1_desc: Free for good and ad-free, built as an ongoing charity (sadaqah jariyah).
strings.about_pillar2_desc: No accounts and no tracking. Prayer times and Qibla are worked out on your phone, and Siraj never uploads your data.
strings.about_pillar3_desc: Verified prayer methods, 15-line Madinah Mushaf, and verified daily Adhkar.
strings.about_share_desc: Share Siraj with family and friends to earn ongoing reward
strings.about_share_text:
Siraj: the Quran, prayer times and adhkar in one free app with no ads.
Google play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.siiraj.app
Website:
https://siiraj.vercel.app
strings.about_siraj_badge: Made with care for the Ummah
strings.about_story_body: Siraj is a quiet, honest place for worship. There are no ads, no subscriptions, no accounts and no tracking, and Siraj never uploads what you read or save. It is simply here to help you read the Quran, keep your prayers on time and stay with your dhikr.
strings.adhan_buttons_setting_body: Pressing the power button stops the adhan screen
strings.adhan_full_screen_permission_body: Android needs your permission to show it over the lock screen.
strings.adhan_match_prayer_body: Shows the sky and sun or moon of the prayer being called, matching the prayer card
strings.adhan_screen_buttons_hint: The power button stops it too
strings.adhan_screen_buttons_hint_both: Power or volume buttons stop it too
strings.adhan_screen_buttons_hint_power: The power button stops it too
strings.adhan_screen_setting_body: Shows the prayer and its time with one large button to stop the adhan, even on the lock screen
strings.adhan_stop_power_body: Pressing the power button turns off the screen and stops the adhan
strings.adhan_stop_volume_body: Press Volume Up or Down to stop the adhan. When off, volume buttons adjust volume.
strings.adhan_voice_no_internet: Connect to the internet to listen
strings.adhan_voice_note_downloading: Downloading your adhan so it plays even without internet.
strings.adhan_voice_note_failed: Couldn't download it. Check your connection, then tap the download button to try again.
strings.adhan_voice_note_on_finish: This one downloads when you finish setting up, so it plays even without internet.
strings.adhan_voice_note_pending: Not downloaded yet. Tap the download button so it plays even without internet.
strings.adhan_voices_note: Listen before you choose. Voices that aren't on your phone yet play from the internet, and the one you pick is downloaded so your adhan plays even without internet.
strings.adhan_volume_body: Sets how loud the adhan plays without changing your phone's alarm volume
strings.adhkar_no_results_hint: Try a shorter word, or part of a title.
strings.adhkar_radio_no_results_hint: Try the name of a station, a reciter or a city.
strings.adhkar_reset_message: Today's count for every dhikr in this set goes back to zero.
strings.adhkar_tap_hint: Tap a card each time you recite it
strings.ambient_credit: Recordings from Freesound, in the public domain
strings.ambient_subtitle: Plays softly under the recitation, and pauses when it pauses.
strings.app_icon_apply_success: App icon updated across Siraj and your home screen
strings.app_icon_sheet_desc: Applies to your home screen, launch screen, and emblem across Siraj
strings.appearance_black_desc: Easier on the battery on many phones
strings.appearance_colors_desc: Select an accent color palette for buttons, badges, and highlights
strings.appearance_glass_mesh_desc: Clear keeps the backdrop glossy and bright, Velvet Satin adds a soft pearlescent veil, and Frosted deepens blur for calmer contrast.
strings.appearance_glass_ui_desc: Cards turn to frosted glass over your background, and the floating bars bend what scrolls under them.
strings.appearance_icon_card_desc: Updates your home screen and the emblem across Siraj, and on Android 13 and newer the launch splash too
strings.appearance_nav_always_small_desc: Keep the tab bar in its compact icon-only size instead of expanding.
strings.appearance_nav_player_follows_desc: The now-playing bar narrows to the same width and sits just above it, so the two stay lined up.
strings.appearance_nav_shrink_desc: As you scroll down, the bar folds to its icons. Scroll back up and it opens again.
strings.appearance_nav_style_desc: Applies to both the tab bar and the Quran player bar.
strings.appearance_preview_ayah: “And We have certainly made the Quran easy for remembrance”
strings.appearance_studio_subtitle: Liquid Glass, live scenes, colors & display
strings.azkar_all_done_desc: May Allah accept your supplications and reward you abundantly.
strings.azkar_card_after_prayer_desc: Tasbih and istighfar after each fard prayer
strings.azkar_purpose_missed_rakah: If you join the prayer late
strings.azkar_screen_verse: In remembrance of Allah hearts find rest
strings.bismillah: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
strings.calendar_events_empty: Occasion dates aren't available for this year.
strings.calendar_out_of_range: This month lies outside the range of the Umm al-Qura calendar.
strings.daily_ayah_translation_missing: No translation downloaded yet. Add one from Settings → Quran & Mushaf.
strings.dashboard_location_no_results_hint: Check the spelling, or choose the country first.
strings.enable_gps_prompt: Turn on location in your phone's settings so Siraj can find your city.
strings.fajr_adhan_body: At Fajr, the adhan with "as-salatu khayrun min an-nawm": prayer is better than sleep.
strings.fajr_adhan_no_version: There is no Fajr recording of {0} yet, so Fajr uses {1}.
strings.fajr_adhan_off: Off. Fajr has the same adhan as the other prayers.
strings.fajr_adhan_pick_note: These are the voices with a Fajr recording. The one you choose is downloaded, so it plays without internet.
strings.fasting_header_sub: Mondays and Thursdays, the White Days and Ramadan, in one place.
strings.fasting_reminder_desc: A reminder the night before a Sunnah fast.
strings.glass_performance_mode_desc: Draws the glass without live blur or refraction, so it costs less battery and stays smooth on older phones.
strings.guide_adhkar_1_body: Tap Worship at the bottom of the screen.
strings.guide_adhkar_2_body: The card at the top follows your day: morning, after prayer, evening, and before sleep. Tap it to begin.
strings.guide_adhkar_3_body: Tap the card each time you say the dhikr. The circle fills up, and a tick appears once you have said it enough times.
strings.guide_adhkar_4_body: Scroll down for every other collection, and for the chapters of Hisn al-Muslim.
strings.guide_appearance_1_body: In Settings, tap Customize on the Appearance card, then tap a colour under Accent Palettes. The whole app changes with it, widgets too.
strings.guide_appearance_2_body: Under Color Mode, choose Light or Dark. Auto follows your phone.
strings.guide_appearance_3_body: Near the end, under Digits & Display, choose Large or Largest next to Text size. The text grows everywhere in Siraj.
strings.guide_appearance_glass_body: Turn on Liquid Glass and the cards become frosted glass over your background, so the scene shows through them.
strings.guide_appearance_live_body: Under Background, turn on Live Animated Background and pick a scene, such as Floating Lanterns or Quiet Snowfall. It moves gently behind every screen, in your colours.
strings.guide_bookmarks_1_body: In the Mushaf, tap the bookmark at the top. It fills in, and a short note tells you the page is saved.
strings.guide_bookmarks_2_body: Press and hold a verse, tap Bookmark, then Save. You can give it a name first if you like.
strings.guide_bookmarks_3_body: Tap the bookmark in the bar at the bottom of the Mushaf to see them all. Tap one to go straight back to it.
strings.guide_calendar_1_body: Tap Worship at the bottom of the screen, then Hijri Calendar.
strings.guide_calendar_2_body: Today is circled, and a dot marks a special day. The card underneath counts down the days to the next one.
strings.guide_calendar_3_body: On the Worship tab, Fasting & Imsakiah shows when suhoor ends and when to break your fast.
strings.guide_downloads_1_body: In the Mushaf, tap the reciter in the bar at the bottom, then Download this surah. Once it is saved, it plays without internet.
strings.guide_downloads_1_title: Save a surah to your phone
strings.guide_downloads_2_body: Settings, then Downloads, shows everything saved on your phone and how much space it takes. You can delete anything there and download it again later.
strings.guide_finish_body: That's every guide. Whenever you need a reminder, they are waiting for you in Settings.
strings.guide_hadith_1_body: On the Worship tab, scroll down to Explore and tap Prophetic Hadiths.
strings.guide_hadith_2_body: The buttons along the top sort the hadith by topic, such as prayer, fasting, or patience in illness. You can also search for a word.
strings.guide_hadith_3_body: Tap a hadith to read it whole, with where it is recorded and its meaning. The buttons underneath copy it or share it.
strings.guide_hub_body: Short guides with moving pictures, there whenever you need them. Watch them all in order, or open just the one you want.
strings.guide_khatma_1_body: Tap Quran at the bottom of the screen. Your khatma is the first card, above the surahs.
strings.guide_khatma_2_body: Pick how many days you want it to take. Each choice shows how many pages a day that means. Then tap Begin.
strings.guide_khatma_3_body: Each day shows the pages to read. Tap Read now to open them, and Mark as read when you finish. If you fall behind, Reschedule spreads the rest over the days left.
strings.guide_library_1_body: On the Worship tab, under Explore, tap the Quran reciters card. It opens the whole library: every reciter, and rare recitations too.
strings.guide_library_2_body: Tap a reciter to see their surahs, and tap a surah to play it. The download button beside it saves it to your phone, so you can listen without internet; Download all saves every one.
strings.guide_library_2_title: Choose a reciter, then a surah
strings.guide_library_3_body: Tap the bar at the bottom to open the full player. Under the play button are Speed and the Sleep timer: choose how fast it recites, or when it should stop.
strings.guide_library_4_body: Swipe the player down, or tap the arrow at its top, and it shrinks back into the bar. The recitation goes on while you use the rest of Siraj.
strings.guide_listening_1_body: In the Mushaf, tap the play button in the bar at the bottom. Each verse lights up as it is recited, so you can follow along. You can try it in the picture above.
strings.guide_listening_2_body: The arrows either side of the play button move back or forward one verse. Tap the button itself to pause.
strings.guide_listening_3_body: Tap the reciter's name in the bar. In the panel that opens, tap Change reciter, then choose the reciter you would like to hear. You can try it in the picture above.
strings.guide_listening_4_body: Press and hold a verse, then tap Play this ayah. Play from here carries on from that verse.
strings.guide_listening_5_body: The recitation carries on when you leave the Mushaf. A small player stays at the bottom of the app, so you can pause or close it from anywhere.
strings.guide_mushaf_1_body: Open Settings, then Mushaf & reading. Choose the Madinah Mushaf, the IndoPak one or the Shamarly, whichever you learned to read from. Every page in Siraj follows your choice.
strings.guide_mushaf_2_body: In the Mushaf, tap the list button at the top to read one ayah at a time in larger letters. Tap the book button to go back to the pages.
strings.guide_mushaf_2_title: Pages, or one ayah at a time
strings.guide_practice_play: Try it: tap the play button
strings.guide_practice_play_done: Well done. The recitation has started.
strings.guide_practice_reciter: Try it: tap the reciter in the bar
strings.guide_practice_reciter_done: Well done. You will now hear {0}.
strings.guide_prayer_1_body: The home screen shows the next prayer and how long is left until it. Tap it to see all of today's times.
strings.guide_prayer_2_body: Prayer times follow your location. Tap the city's name at the top to change it, or to choose a city yourself.
strings.guide_prayer_3_body: To choose the muezzin, or a short tone or silence instead, open Settings and tap Adhan & reminders.
strings.guide_qibla_1_body: Tap Qibla at the bottom of the screen.
strings.guide_qibla_2_body: Hold the phone flat and turn slowly until the Kaaba meets the marker at the top. A gentle buzz tells you that you are facing the Qibla.
strings.guide_radio_1_body: Open Worship and tap the Quran radio card.
strings.guide_radio_2_body: Tap any station to listen live. Tap it again to stop.
strings.guide_radio_3_body: The radio keeps playing while you use the rest of the app, even with the screen off. The small player at the bottom pauses or closes it.
strings.guide_reading_1_body: Tap Quran at the bottom of the screen. Every surah is there, ready to read.
strings.guide_reading_2_body: The button beside the search box switches between the list of surahs and the list of the thirty juz.
strings.guide_reading_2_title: Surahs or juz, as you like
strings.guide_reading_3_body: Tap any surah or juz, and the Mushaf opens at its first page.
strings.guide_reading_4_body: Swipe sideways, just as you would turn the pages of a printed Mushaf. Tap the page once for a calm view without buttons, and again to bring them back.
strings.guide_reading_5_body: Tap the surah's name at the top to jump to another surah, juz or page.
strings.guide_search_1_body: On the Quran tab, tap the search box and type a few words of the ayah in Arabic. Every ayah that has them is listed. Tap one to open it.
strings.guide_search_2_body: Type the surah's number and the ayah's number, like 2:255, or the surah's name and the number. Siraj opens that ayah for you.
strings.guide_tafsir_1_body: Press and hold the verse you would like to understand, until its options open.
strings.guide_tafsir_3_body: The explanation opens below the page. Tap A+ for bigger words, or All books to read another tafsir.
strings.guide_tafsir_3_title: Read at a size that suits you
strings.guide_tasbih_1_body: On the home screen, tap Tasbih.
strings.guide_tasbih_2_body: Tap the big circle each time you say the dhikr. The arrows beside the words change the dhikr.
strings.guide_text_size_body: Make words and numbers bigger everywhere in Siraj. The Quran's own text size is under Mushaf & reading.
strings.guide_text_size_sample: This is how your text will look.
strings.guide_tips_body: The first time you reach a button, a short note lights it up and explains it.
strings.guide_tips_title: Show tips as I use Siraj
strings.guide_topic_adhkar_summary: Morning and evening adhkar, with a counter
strings.guide_topic_appearance: Colours, live scenes and text size
strings.guide_topic_appearance_summary: Make Siraj look the way you like
strings.guide_topic_bookmarks_summary: Keep your place, and find it again
strings.guide_topic_calendar_summary: Dates, coming occasions and fasting times
strings.guide_topic_downloads_summary: Save a surah, and see what is saved
strings.guide_topic_hadith_summary: Authentic hadith by topic, with their meaning
strings.guide_topic_khatma_summary: A khatma, a few pages a day
strings.guide_topic_library_summary: Whole surahs by many reciters, and the full-screen player
strings.guide_topic_listening_summary: Play, pause, and choose your reciter
strings.guide_topic_mushaf_summary: Madinah, IndoPak or Shamarly, pages or one ayah at a time
strings.guide_topic_prayer_summary: The next prayer, your city, and the adhan
strings.guide_topic_qibla_summary: Find the direction of the Kaaba
strings.guide_topic_reading_summary: Surahs and juz, opening a surah, turning pages
strings.guide_topic_search_summary: Search by words, or go straight to an ayah
strings.guide_topic_tafsir_summary: Understand the meaning of any verse
strings.guide_topic_widgets_summary: Prayer times, a verse or the Hijri date, without opening Siraj
strings.guide_tour_length: About ten minutes · stop whenever you like
strings.guide_walkthrough_body: A short tour of the real app: each part and its most useful buttons, one at a time.
strings.guide_welcome_body: Would you like a quick tour? We'll walk you round the app itself, one button at a time: the prayer times, the Quran and its reciters, the Qibla, the adhkar and Settings. It takes two or three minutes.
strings.guide_welcome_footnote: The guide is always in Settings if you want it later.
strings.guide_widgets_1_body: Open Settings and tap Browse the widgets, under Home-screen widgets.
strings.guide_widgets_2_body: Swipe through them, or tap a name along the top. Under each, choose its background - soft, filled, glass or none - and its colour.
strings.guide_widgets_3_body: Tap Add to home screen, then confirm. To resize it, press and hold it on your home screen and drag its edges; to change how it looks, hold it and tap Settings.
strings.guide_widgets_3_title: Add it to your home screen
strings.hijri_adjust_body: If your mosque or country announced a different day, move the date to match it.
strings.hijri_adjust_earlier: Move the date one day earlier
strings.hijri_adjust_later: Move the date one day later
strings.hijri_mode_umm_al_qura_body: Saudi Arabia's official calendar, wherever you are
strings.ios_live_activity_desc: Shows the next prayer countdown while active. For an always-on 24/7 countdown, add Siraj's Lock Screen widget.
strings.ios_lockscreen_widget_desc: Always-on offline countdown to the next prayer.
strings.ios_milestone_azkar_desc: Hisn al-Muslim adhkar, Tasbih, Hadith, 99 Names, Quran Radio, Fasting, and Zakat arrive in the daily tools update.
strings.ios_milestone_qibla_desc: The live compass and Qibla finder arrive in the daily tools update.
strings.ios_milestone_quran_desc: The 604-page Mushaf, recitation, Listen Hub, Khatma, and video export arrive in the next update.
strings.ios_notification_sound_note: iOS plays up to 30 seconds of the selected adhan on the lock screen; tap the alert to hear the full adhan.
strings.ios_widget_gallery_hint: Long-press your Home Screen or Lock Screen, tap Edit → Add Widget, and choose Siraj. Tap any placed widget to pick its face and palette.
strings.kh_card_empty: Start a khatma and read a little every day
strings.kh_end_confirm: Your progress in this khatma will be lost. The Quran itself keeps your last read position.
strings.kh_finished_body: May Allah accept it from you.
strings.kh_pages_needed_ready: The Quran database is still downloading, so the plan shows page numbers only for now.
strings.kh_reminder_desc: A nudge at the time you choose, with the pages for that day.
strings.kh_reschedule_desc: Spread what is left over the days that remain, keeping the same finish date.
strings.kh_setup_headline: When would you like to finish?
strings.kh_setup_sub: Choose a length and Siraj works out what to read each day.
strings.last_read_khatma_here: Your khatma's portion starts here too
strings.listen_card_subtitle: Full and rare recitations, offline too
strings.listen_empty_offline: Nothing is on your phone yet. Open a reciter and download a surah, or the whole recitation, to listen without internet.
strings.listen_error: Couldn't play it. Check your internet connection, or download it to listen offline.
strings.listen_remove_rare_body: These recordings are deleted from your phone. You can download them again at any time.
strings.listen_remove_reciter_body: Every surah of this reciter on your phone is deleted, in the Quran reader too. You can download them again at any time.
strings.listen_selected_bio: Surahs he recorded in full, and passages he chose to recite, in the order of the Mushaf.
strings.listen_state_failed: Couldn't download. Tap to try again.
strings.listen_subtitle: Reciters, online or saved on your phone
strings.listen_whole_surahs_bio: The surahs of his recitation that are available, each one complete, in the order of the Mushaf.
strings.listen_zaher_bio: One of the great reciters of Egypt. He left no complete recording of the Quran; these are the passages of his recitation that survive.
strings.live_theme_amoled_desc: Deep pitch-black dark surfaces that preserve contrast and battery
strings.live_theme_classic_palettes_desc: Curated calm and timeless color accents for Siraj
strings.live_theme_contours_sub: The lines of a hill map, drawn faintly behind the words
strings.live_theme_harvest_sub: Maple and oak leaves drifting down in warm light
strings.live_theme_intensity_desc: Balance background richness with card contrast
strings.live_theme_lava_lamp_sub: Soft drops of colour that slowly rise and sink
strings.live_theme_live_bg_desc: Bring serene natural horizons to life across your screens, with or without Liquid Glass
strings.live_theme_mosaic_sub: Facets of glass that catch the light now and then
strings.live_theme_palette_sync_desc: Automatically pair button and highlight colors with the active live scene
strings.live_theme_particles_sub: Stars joined by fine threads of light
strings.live_theme_rings_sub: Rings spreading slowly over still water
strings.live_theme_rose_sub: Drifting blossoms in a gentle breeze
strings.live_theme_section_subtitle: Handcrafted horizons that work seamlessly with both Solid Material and Liquid Glass
strings.live_theme_silk_sub: Fine ribbons of silk rippling in a slow breeze
strings.live_theme_sky_sync_desc: Gently shifts sky tones from Fajr dawn and golden Asr to starlit Isha
strings.live_theme_space_sub: Calm stars, soft nebulae and now and then a shooting star
strings.live_theme_stage_tap_hint: Select any scene below to apply immediately
strings.live_theme_waves_sub: Soft hills and swells that rise and fall slowly
strings.live_theme_weather_desc: Gently shifts sky tones from Fajr dawn and golden Asr to starlit Isha
strings.location_auto_desc: Finds your city by itself. Siraj never uploads your location.
strings.location_detected_sub: Prayer times and Qibla are set for here.
strings.location_detecting_sub: This usually takes a few seconds.
strings.location_gps_off_desc: Turn it on so Siraj can find your city, or choose it yourself.
strings.location_permission_needed_desc: So Siraj can find your city. You can also choose it yourself.
strings.location_required_desc: Turn on location to see prayer times for your city.
strings.looks_background_desc: Plain, or a quiet scene that moves gently behind every screen. It is painted in your colours.
strings.names_hadith_text: “Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one; whoever learns them by heart enters Paradise.”
strings.onb_alerts_kind_full_hint: The full adhan plays at each prayer time, in the voice you choose below.
strings.onb_alerts_kind_silent_hint: A notification with no sound at all, for times when you'd rather nothing is heard.
strings.onb_alerts_kind_tone_hint: Your phone's usual notification sound, with the prayer's name. Short and quiet.
strings.onb_alerts_next_hint: Next, you'll choose how it looks and try it for yourself.
strings.onb_easy_alerts_desc: Siraj can play the adhan when each prayer time begins, even when the app is closed.
strings.onb_easy_alerts_sound_heading: What would you like to hear?
strings.onb_easy_alerts_why: Your phone will then ask if Siraj may send notifications; please allow it, as that is how the adhan reaches you.
strings.onb_easy_battery_why: Some phones stop apps to save battery, so tap Allow and your phone will ask to let Siraj play the adhan on time.
strings.onb_easy_calc_hint_general: We chose a method used in many countries. Change it only if your mosque uses another.
strings.onb_easy_calc_hint_local: We chose the method used in your country. Change it only if your mosque uses another.
strings.onb_easy_done_desc: That's everything. Here is what you chose, and you can change any of it later in Settings.
strings.onb_easy_edition_chosen: We picked this script from your language. Tap another if that is the Mushaf you read from.
strings.onb_easy_lang_desc: Prayer times, the Quran and adhkar, all in one place. Let's begin with your language.
strings.onb_easy_loc_desc: Your prayer times and the Qibla depend on your city.
strings.onb_easy_loc_mode_heading: How should Siraj find your city?
strings.onb_easy_loc_why: Your phone will ask if Siraj may use your location: it is used only to work out your prayer times and Qibla, and Siraj never uploads it.
strings.onb_easy_reading_desc: Choose how the pages look. You can change this later.
strings.onb_easy_reading_layout_heading: Whole pages, or one ayah at a time?
strings.onb_easy_reading_title: How would you like to read the Quran?
strings.onb_easy_reciter_list_hint: Tap a name to make it your reciter.
strings.onb_easy_style_desc: Pick a colour, then light or dark. The app changes as soon as you tap.
strings.onb_easy_we_chose: We chose these for you. You can leave them as they are.
strings.onb_edition_hint: The pages above show the script you pick. You can change it any time in Settings.
strings.onb_edition_indopak_desc: The 15-line script read across South Asia.
strings.onb_edition_madinah_desc: The King Fahd Complex print, in the Uthmani script.
strings.onb_edition_shamarly_desc: The Egyptian 15-line print, in Amiri Quran type.
strings.onb_lang_time_note: Setting up takes about two minutes, and you can change anything later.
strings.onb_look_before_hint: A gentle notice a few minutes early, so you have time for wudu and to get ready.
strings.onb_look_countdown_off: Off. The adhan still comes at every prayer.
strings.onb_look_countdown_on: It sits quietly in your notifications and counts down to the next prayer. It also helps your phone call the adhan on time.
strings.onb_look_desc: Choose what you see at prayer time. Then try it, and you'll see and hear exactly what will happen.
strings.onb_look_notification_body: The adhan plays with a notification at the top of the screen, like any other app's.
strings.onb_look_off_body: There's nothing to choose here until they're on. You can go back and turn them on, or carry on without them.
strings.onb_look_screen_body: The prayer and its time fill the screen, with one big button to stop the adhan. It shows even when the phone is locked.
strings.onb_look_title: How should the adhan reach you?
strings.onb_look_try_body_full: Hear the next prayer's adhan right now, exactly as it will come at prayer time. Stop it whenever you like.
strings.onb_look_try_body_tone: Get the next prayer's alert right now, exactly as it will come at prayer time.
strings.onb_look_try_sent: Sent. Swipe down from the top of your screen to see it.
strings.onb_reciter_default_body: {0} will recite whenever you listen to the Quran. You can change this any time: while listening, tap the player at the bottom of the Quran page and choose another reciter.
strings.onboarding_alerts_battery_desc: Some phones pause apps to save battery. Let Siraj run in the background so you never miss an adhan.
strings.onboarding_alerts_blocked: Notifications are turned off for Siraj. Turn them on in your phone's settings.
strings.onboarding_alerts_desc: Hear the adhan when each prayer time begins, even with the app closed.
strings.onboarding_alerts_master_off: Siraj will ask for permission to notify you.
strings.onboarding_calc_hint_general: Used across much of the world. Change it if your mosque follows another.
strings.onboarding_calc_hint_local: Chosen for your area. Change it if your mosque follows another.
strings.onboarding_change_later: You can change any of this later in Settings.
strings.onboarding_done_desc: Siraj is ready. You can change any of these later in Settings.
strings.onboarding_lang_desc: Prayer times, the Quran, and Adhkar all in one place. Pick the language you want to use.
strings.onboarding_loc_desc: Your city sets your prayer times and Qibla. Siraj never uploads your location.
strings.onboarding_polish_background_hint: A plain colour, or a quiet scene that moves gently behind everything. It follows the colours you chose.
strings.onboarding_polish_glass_frost_hint: Pick how much the glass blurs and shimmers: bright Clear Liquid, silky Velvet Satin, or creamy Frosted.
strings.onboarding_polish_glass_hint: Cards and bars turn into soft glass you can see the background through.
strings.onboarding_polish_location_refused_body: That's fine. Choose your city below and the prayer times will follow it. If you'd rather Siraj found you itself, allow location in the app's settings.
strings.onboarding_polish_widgets_action: Finish and show me the widgets
strings.onboarding_polish_widgets_body: Pick from seventeen widgets, from a verse of the Quran to the next prayer in calligraphy, and give each its own colour and background, or none at all.
strings.onboarding_polish_widgets_title: Prayer times on your home screen
strings.onboarding_reading_ayahs_desc: Scroll down verse by verse. Play, bookmark or share any ayah.
strings.onboarding_reading_desc: Pick a layout for the Quran. Both show the same Mushaf text.
strings.onboarding_reading_pages_desc: Swipe page by page, just like a printed Mushaf.
strings.onboarding_reading_paper_desc: Your Quran pages keep their own colours, whatever the app's theme. The pages above change as you choose.
strings.onboarding_reading_switch_hint: You can switch any time with the button at the top of the reader.
strings.onboarding_reading_title: How do you like to read?
strings.onboarding_reciter_desc: The voice you'll hear when you listen to the Quran. You can change it any time.
strings.onboarding_style_desc: Pick a colour, and light or dark. The app changes as you tap.
strings.palette_system_desc: Uses the colors of your wallpaper, like the rest of your phone
strings.ply_highlight_desc: Follow the verse being recited with a soft highlight.
strings.ply_highlight_prompt_body: To keep the highlight on the ayah being recited, {0} is played one ayah at a time, with a short pause after each. Leave highlighting off and each ayah follows straight on from the last, much as it does in Listen to the Quran.
strings.pre_prayer_channel_desc: A notice a few minutes before each prayer
strings.pre_prayer_desc_off: A notice a few minutes before each prayer, to get ready for it.
strings.pre_prayer_notification_body_iqama: The adhan is at {0}, Iqama at {1}.
strings.qibla_calibration_hint: Lay your phone flat, then move it in a figure-8 to re-calibrate the compass.
strings.qibla_desc_failed: We couldn't find where you are just now. Make sure location is on, then try again.
strings.qibla_desc_gps: Your phone's location is turned off. Turn it on in Settings and the Qibla will appear.
strings.qibla_desc_permission: To point you to the Kaaba from where you are, Siraj needs your precise location.
strings.quran_auto_scroll_desc: Follows the reciter while a recitation plays
strings.quran_edition_indopak_desc: The 15-line IndoPak script read across South Asia (610 pages)
strings.quran_edition_madinah_desc: The printed King Fahd Complex pages, in their own script (604 pages)
strings.quran_edition_shamarly_desc: The pages and lines of the Egyptian Shamarly print, in Amiri Quran type (521 pages)
strings.quran_font_size_desc: Larger sizes scroll down the page
strings.quran_index_search_hint: Search surah, ayah, juz or page
strings.quran_no_bookmarks: No bookmarks yet — tap any ayah to save one.
strings.quran_no_bookmarks_category: No bookmarks in this category yet.
strings.quran_player_progress_desc: Show the recitation's position under the player, and drag it to seek
strings.quran_polish_action_note_description: Write a note on this ayah
strings.quran_polish_no_results_body: Try the surah's name or its number.
strings.quran_polish_play_from_here_sub: On to the end of the surah
strings.quran_polish_tafsir_error_body: Check your connection, or read this ayah in another book.
strings.quran_polish_translation_unavailable: No translation of this ayah is available offline.
strings.quran_video_clip_failed: This background could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
strings.quran_video_clips_note: Real footage from Pexels. Each one downloads once, the first time you choose it.
strings.quran_video_failed_offline: The recitation could not be fetched. Check the connection and try again.
strings.quran_video_failed_render: The video could not be made on this phone. Try another background, or 720p.
strings.quran_video_gallery_desc: Choose a photo or a video from this phone
strings.quran_video_gallery_note: A video of your own loops for as long as the recitation lasts, without its sound.
strings.quran_video_keep_open: Keep {0} open until it is done.
strings.quran_video_max_note: Up to {0} verses in one video.
strings.quran_video_quality_desc: 720p makes a smaller file, 1080p a sharper picture.
strings.quran_video_ready_hint: Tap the video to play it.
strings.quran_video_save_failed: The video could not be saved
strings.quran_video_saved_gallery: Saved in your gallery, in Movies/Siraj
strings.quran_video_shape_desc: Tall for stories and status, wide for a big screen.
strings.quran_video_under_no_meaning: To show the meaning, download a translation in Quran settings.
strings.quran_video_under_tafsir_note: The tafsir is al-Muyassar, in Arabic.
strings.radio_error: Couldn't reach this station. Tap play to try again.
strings.radio_hero_subtitle: Live Quran stations and recitation channels from renowned reciters
strings.radio_tap_to_browse_channels: Tap to browse all stations & reciters
strings.rdl_all_downloaded: Every surah is on this device
strings.rdl_large_download_note: This is a large download. Wi-Fi is recommended.
strings.rdl_no_results_downloaded: Nothing downloaded from this reciter yet
strings.rdl_remove_dialog_body: Every surah downloaded for {0} will be deleted from this device. You can download them again at any time.
strings.rdl_search_hint: Search by surah name or number
strings.rdl_stay_on_screen: Downloading stops if you leave this screen.
strings.rdl_stop_note: Stops straight away. Anything already downloaded stays.
strings.reader_landscape_double_desc: Like an open Mushaf, both pages at once
strings.reader_landscape_single_desc: Larger text. Scroll down the page, swipe for the next
strings.reciter_picker_empty_body: Try another name, or clear the filters.
strings.reminders_azan_offline_notice: The muezzin you choose is saved on your phone, so the full adhan plays even without internet.
strings.reminders_battery_opt_granted_desc: Battery saver won't stop Siraj in the background.
strings.reminders_battery_opt_warning_desc: Let Siraj run in the background so alerts arrive on time.
strings.reminders_battery_opt_warning_title: Battery saver may delay the adhan
strings.reminders_duha_desc: Mid-morning, once the sun is up
strings.reminders_empty_custom: None yet. Tap Add reminder to set your own, like a daily wird.
strings.reminders_exact_alarm_warning_desc: Android is holding back exact alarms for Siraj. Allow them so the adhan sounds right at prayer time.
strings.reminders_fasting_days_desc: Cherished weekly Sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ)
strings.reminders_kahf_desc: A light between the two Fridays
strings.reminders_live_updates_desc: Keeps a countdown to the next prayer in your notifications. It also helps your phone deliver the adhan on time.
strings.reminders_new_desc: Set aside time in this Dunya for your Akhira.
strings.reminders_qiyam_desc: In the last third of the night
strings.reminders_repaired_body: A setup problem had left all five prayer alerts switched off, so the adhan never sounded. They are on again. You can turn any of them off in Settings → Reminders.
strings.reminders_sunrise_desc: End of Fajr time · no adhan
strings.reminders_verse_day_desc: One verse to reflect on each day
strings.settings_appearance_card_subtitle: Customize Liquid Glass, live horizons, colors, app icon & text size
strings.settings_appearance_desc: App colors, dark mode, text size, and motion
strings.settings_asr_standard_desc: Shafi'i, Maliki and Hanbali · the earlier time
strings.settings_auto_pause_music_desc: Pauses playing music or media when an Adhan alert fires and resumes it automatically once the Adhan finishes.
strings.settings_calc_advanced_desc: Only needed if your times don't match your mosque
strings.settings_calc_high_latitude_desc: Where the sky never gets fully dark in summer, this decides Fajr and Isha.
strings.settings_calc_madhab_desc: Schools differ on when Asr begins. Choose the one you follow.
strings.settings_calc_method_desc: Choose the one your local mosque follows. Not sure? Pick the one used in your country.
strings.settings_calc_offsets_desc: Move a time earlier (−) or later (+) to match your mosque.
strings.settings_developed_with: Developed with care and devotion for the Ummah.
strings.settings_download_full: Recitations, adhan sounds and books on this phone
strings.settings_experimental_desc: Try new features early. Behavior may vary by phone or media app.
strings.settings_guide_body: A tour of the app, illustrated guides and the text size
strings.settings_haptic_desc: A light buzz as you count and tap
strings.settings_hide_completed_desc: A dhikr leaves the list once you finish its count
strings.settings_location_and_prayer_times_desc: City, calculation method, and Hijri calendar
strings.settings_location_desc: Sets your prayer times and Qibla
strings.settings_motion_desc: Calmer screens, and smoother on older phones
strings.settings_mushaf_black_override: The app's Black theme is on, so night pages are pure black.
strings.settings_mushaf_color_sepia_desc: Gentle on the eyes for long reading
strings.settings_mushaf_color_white_desc: Crisp, bright, and easy to read
strings.settings_mushaf_dark_charcoal_desc: Balanced dark tone, easy on the eyes
strings.settings_mushaf_dark_navy_desc: Deep calming blue for quiet nights
strings.settings_mushaf_theme_system_desc: Light by day and dark at night, following your phone
strings.settings_prayer_calculation_desc: Calculation method, Asr time and small adjustments
strings.settings_quran_mushaf_desc: Mushaf, text size, reciter and tafsir
strings.settings_quran_numeral_desc: Keeps ١٢٣ in the Quran, even if the rest of the app uses 123
strings.settings_quran_scroll_horizontal_desc: Left and right, like a printed Mushaf
strings.settings_quran_scroll_vertical_desc: Up and down, verse after verse
strings.settings_quran_video_desc: Verses recited over a background, with their words on screen, to save or share.
strings.settings_reminders_desc: Adhan sound, prayer alerts and daily reminders
strings.settings_show_last_bookmark_desc: A card on Home that opens the Quran where you stopped
strings.settings_show_translation_desc: The meaning of each dhikr in your language
strings.settings_show_transliteration_desc: The Arabic written in Latin letters
strings.settings_show_virtues_desc: Why each dhikr is said, and what each hadith teaches. Stays on when the translation is off.
strings.settings_sound_effects_desc: A soft click with each count
strings.settings_updates_notice_desc: Tell me when a new version is out
strings.setup_background_progress: Downloading the Mushaf in the background · {0}
strings.setup_body: Siraj is downloading the Quran text and page fonts. This happens once only.
strings.setup_failed_body: The download did not finish. Check your connection and try again — it will pick up where it stopped.
strings.splash_verse: « وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيرًا »
strings.storage_clear_desc: All saved recitations and adhan sounds will be removed. Your tafsir and translation books stay.
strings.storage_delete_desc: You can download it again at any time.
strings.storage_empty_recitations: None saved. Recitations play online until you download them.
strings.storage_quran_data_desc: Downloaded once during setup. It stays on your phone and works without internet.
strings.storage_quran_data_title: Quran text, Mushaf pages and Al-Muyassar
strings.text_size_body: Make words and numbers bigger everywhere in Siraj. The Quran's own text size is under Mushaf & reading.
strings.text_size_sample: This is how your text will look.
strings.tfs_all_downloaded: Every book is on this device
strings.tfs_empty: This book has no commentary on this ayah.
strings.tfs_library_subtitle: Choose what you read alongside the Quran
strings.tfs_no_results_downloaded: Nothing downloaded yet besides the built-in tafsir
strings.tfs_only_builtin: Only the built-in tafsir is on this device
strings.tfs_remove_body: The book will be deleted from this device. You can download it again at any time.
strings.tfs_stay_on_screen: Leaving this screen stops the queue.
strings.tip_adhkar_count_body: Tap the card each time you say the dhikr. It is ticked once you have said it enough times.
strings.tip_adhkar_today_body: This card follows the time of day: morning, after prayer, evening and before sleep. Tap it to begin.
strings.tip_listen_open_body: Whole surahs by many reciters, and rare recordings too. Tap to choose a reciter; any surah can be saved to listen without internet.
strings.tip_quran_open_body: Tap any surah or juz, and the Mushaf opens at its first page.
strings.tip_quran_switch_body: Tap this button to switch between the list of surahs and the list of juz.
strings.tip_radio_open_body: Live Quran broadcasts and channels of well-known reciters. Tap to see every station.
strings.tip_radio_play_body: It keeps playing while you use the rest of the app. Tap the same station again to stop it.
strings.tip_reader_bookmark_body: Tap here to bookmark this page. To find your bookmarks later, tap the bookmark in the bar at the bottom.
strings.tip_reader_hold_body: Keep your finger on a verse for a moment. You can then listen to it, bookmark it, read its tafsir, copy it or share it.
strings.tip_reader_play_body: Tap play to hear this page recited. To choose another reciter, tap the reciter's name.
strings.tools_fasting_logs_empty_body: Tap a day on the calendar, or log today above, and it will appear here.
strings.tools_fasting_times_unavailable: Set a location to see today's times.
strings.tools_hadith_empty_body: Try another word, or clear the search and the filter.
strings.tools_names_empty_body: Search by the Arabic name, its transliteration or its meaning.
strings.tools_qibla_calibrate_now: The compass needs calibrating. Move your phone in a figure-8 a few times, away from metal and magnets.
strings.tools_qibla_dial_a11y: Compass. The Qibla is {0} degrees from north.
strings.tools_qibla_guide: Hold the phone flat and turn until the Kaaba meets the marker at the top.
strings.tools_qibla_no_compass: No compass on this phone. Face {0}° from north.
strings.tools_tasbih_reset_body: The counter goes back to zero. Today's total is kept.
strings.tools_zakat_need_amount: Enter at least one amount to calculate.
strings.tools_zakat_need_price: Enter a price above zero so the nisab can be worked out.
strings.tools_zakat_nisab_body: The nisab is the least wealth on which zakat is due: the value of {0} g of silver, or {1} g of gold when no silver price is set. If what you own reaches it and has been held for a full lunar year, {2} of it is due.
strings.tour_adhan_body: When the adhan is called, the full-screen alert now opens onto a calm, animated sky that matches the prayer—sun by day, crescent at dawn and night. Open Adhan & reminders to customize it or hear the clearer Fajr adhans.
strings.tour_appearance_body: Open Appearance to try the Glass UI, seventeen moving live scenes (lanterns, sea waves, snowfall, shooting stars and more), 12 app icons, and a tab bar that can switch shapes or shrink while you scroll.
strings.tour_done_body: That is the whole app. Tap Finish to go back to the prayer times. May Allah make it of benefit to you.
strings.tour_listen_body: In the listening library, Mishary Alafasy and Maher Al-Mu'aiqly now recite each surah as one continuous recording, and 36 more reciters have joined. Stream any surah or download it for offline listening.
strings.tour_mushaf_body: Open Mushaf & reading to read in the new 15-line Egyptian Shamarly Mushaf with framed surah headings in Amiri Quran type, or switch between the Madinah and IndoPak Mushafs any time.
strings.tour_new_done_body: The full list is under What's new in Settings whenever you want it. Tap Finish to go back to the prayer times.
strings.tour_new_reader_body: Surahs now open straight away. The player shows the reciter's photo and the ayah being recited, the tafsir quotes the ayah it explains and takes you on to the next one, and two fingers no longer zoom the page by accident.
strings.tour_new_start_body: A quick look at what changed, each thing where you'll find it. Tap Next to go on, or End tour to stop.
strings.tour_next_prayer_body: This card shows which prayer is next and how long is left until it. Tap it any time to see all of today’s prayer times.
strings.tour_settings_guide_body: Open the guide here whenever you need it. You can take this tour again from there too.
strings.tour_shortcuts_body: Open the Mushaf in one tap, or go straight to the tasbih, listening to the Quran, or the duas.
strings.tour_start_body: We'll show you around, one thing at a time. It takes two or three minutes. Tap Next to go on, the arrow to go back a step, or End tour to stop whenever you like.
strings.tour_tab_adhkar_body: Tap Worship for the morning and evening adhkar, duas, Quran radio and the reciters.
strings.tour_tab_qibla_body: Tap Qibla to find the direction of the Kaaba wherever you are. Hold the phone flat for the best reading.
strings.tour_tab_quran_body: Tap Quran at the bottom of the screen to see every surah and juz.
strings.tour_tab_settings_body: Tap Settings to change the adhan, your Mushaf, the text size, the language and the colours.
strings.tour_widgets_body: Open the widget gallery to see the four new clock faces—handwritten, marker, and two analog dials—along with brighter glass widgets for your home screen.
strings.tour_your_adhan_body: Tap Adhan & reminders to choose the muezzin, or a short tone or silence instead. Reminders for the adhkar, Surah Al-Kahf on Friday and more are here too.
strings.tour_your_look_body: Tap Customize for colours, light or dark, Liquid Glass, a live scene behind every screen, the app icon and the text size.
strings.tour_your_mushaf_body: Tap Mushaf & reading to read in the Madinah, IndoPak or Shamarly Mushaf, whichever you learned from.
strings.tour_your_widgets_body: Put the prayer times, a verse or the Hijri date on your home screen. Tap Browse the widgets to pick one.
strings.translation_pending_notice: Showing the English translation. Translations in more languages are on the way.
strings.update_available_body: There's an update for Siraj on Google Play. It downloads in the background, so you can keep using the app.
strings.whatsnew_130_battery_body: The notification countdown updates on its own, location checks run less often, and sky animations pause in Battery Saver. The adhan itself still fires right on time.
strings.whatsnew_130_fix_clock: The prayer notification now follows your 12-hour or 24-hour clock choice.
strings.whatsnew_130_fix_motion: Loading indicators now respect your phone's animation settings too.
strings.whatsnew_130_fix_note: Double-tapping Save on a note no longer closes the app.
strings.whatsnew_130_fix_version: Your version number now appears on the About Siraj screen again.
strings.whatsnew_130_layout_body: Read one ayah at a time or flip through Mushaf pages. The toggle at the top of the reader lets you switch whenever you like.
strings.whatsnew_130_layout_title: Mushaf pages or ayah by ayah
strings.whatsnew_130_motion_body: Transitions across the app move more gently now. Reduce animations in Settings still turns motion off completely.
strings.whatsnew_130_startup_body: Trimmed down what Siraj runs at launch so your prayer times appear sooner.
strings.whatsnew_130_updates_body: Siraj lets you know when a new version is ready on Google Play and shows a summary like this afterwards. You can turn notices off in Settings.
strings.whatsnew_130_widgets_body: Four widgets to choose from: next prayer with a live countdown, today's schedule in a row or a list, and a clock with both calendars. Available as a solid card in your colours or frosted glass.
strings.whatsnew_130_widgets_title: Prayer times on your home screen
strings.whatsnew_150_adhan_buttons_body: Press the power button or either volume key to stop the adhan right away without reaching for the screen.
strings.whatsnew_150_adhan_screen_body: When the adhan starts, the screen lights up with the prayer name, time and one large stop button. Works over the lock screen too.
strings.whatsnew_150_calendar_body: A tidier monthly view that makes it easier to follow Hijri dates, voluntary fasts (Mondays, Thursdays and the White Days) and upcoming occasions.
strings.whatsnew_150_colours_body: Olive, Burgundy and Slate are now in Settings, and Sand has been warmed up slightly for a softer look.
strings.whatsnew_150_designs_body: Pin an ayah, hadith or dhikr to your home screen as a printed-style card or on frosted glass, alongside a calligraphed Hijri month widget. Take a look in the widget gallery.
strings.whatsnew_150_guides_body: Step-by-step animated guides now walk through keeping a khatma, reading the Hijri calendar and fasting days, adding widgets, and changing colours, dark mode and text size. Find them under Guide at the top of Settings.
strings.whatsnew_150_hijri_offset_body: Move the Hijri calendar forward or back by a day or two in Settings if local moon sighting differs. Your dates and fasting reminders stay in step.
strings.whatsnew_150_motion_body: Moving between screens feels brisker and lighter, without jarring jumps.
strings.whatsnew_150_quran_fonts_body: Resize the Quran text and watch the page update on the spot before leaving settings, with sharper rendering across the script.
strings.whatsnew_150_quran_index_body: Browse by surah, juz or hizb, check ayah counts and Meccan or Medinan origins, and jump back to where you stopped reading.
strings.whatsnew_150_quran_search_body: Type a few words you remember, or search a reference like “2:255” or “Al-Baqarah 255” to jump straight to that verse and its page.
strings.whatsnew_150_radio_pinned_body: Pin the radio channels you listen to most so they stay at the top. Tarateel and Ruqyah have moved into Recitations where they are easier to find.
strings.whatsnew_150_radio_stations_body: Added channels from Oman and Jordan, continuous Surat al-Baqarah, 24-hour Ruqyah, Quran with English translation, and recitations by Mishary Alafasy and Abdul Basit.
strings.whatsnew_150_sky_body: The prayer card sky follows your day from dawn through afternoon sun to sunset and night, timed to your local prayers.
strings.whatsnew_150_sky_title: Day-long sky on the prayer card
strings.whatsnew_150_widget_settings_body: Give each widget a solid card, frosted glass or no background at all over your wallpaper, and set how often verses refresh.
strings.whatsnew_152_clocks_body: Have the time written by hand or in thick marker, or go analogue with a hand-drawn dial or a star dial. We also sharpened the light along the edges of the glass widgets.
strings.whatsnew_152_dock_body: The tab bar and the Quran player bar have rounded corners now. With Liquid Glass off, the tab bar becomes a solid card with a soft shadow and a highlight that slides to the tab you pick. Miss the pill? Choose Pill under Tab bar in Appearance.
strings.whatsnew_152_fajr_body: We cleaned the hall echo and low rumble out of Abdul Basit's Fajr adhan and evened out its volume with the others. Makkah's Fajr adhan is now a clearer recording of Sheikh Ali Mulla from the Haram. If either is your Fajr adhan, Siraj downloads the new one the next time you open it online.
strings.whatsnew_152_fix_adhan_stop: Once you stop the adhan, it stays stopped. In rare cases it used to start again for the same prayer.
strings.whatsnew_152_glass_body: Cards, the tab bar and the player now look like frosted glass over your background, in every colour and in light or dark mode. You can turn Liquid Glass off in Appearance.
strings.whatsnew_152_icons_body: Appearance has 12 icons to choose from. Pick one and Siraj's icon on your home screen changes to match. On Android 13 and newer, the app opens with it as well.
strings.whatsnew_152_listen_body: In the listening library, Mishary Alafasy and Maher Al-Mu'aiqly now recite each surah as one unbroken recording, with no pause between ayahs. We also added 36 reciters, Idris Abkar, Fares Abbad, Salah Bukhatir and Abdullah al-Juhany among them.
strings.whatsnew_152_navfold_body: Turn on “Shrink while scrolling” in Appearance. Scroll down and the tab bar folds to its icons; scroll back up and it returns. The player bar can shrink along with it.
strings.whatsnew_152_navfold_title: A tab bar that gets out of the way
strings.whatsnew_152_scenes_body: Put a slow, living scene behind the whole app. There are 17 of them: floating lanterns, sea waves, falling snow, a night full of stars and more. Each one picks up your colours, with or without Liquid Glass.
strings.whatsnew_152_white_body: Three new, quieter colours in Settings, each tuned for light and dark mode.
strings.whatsnew_153_adhan_screen_body: When the adhan starts, the screen shows that prayer's sky: the sun during the day, a crescent at Fajr and at night. Prefer it plain? Turn off “Match prayer sky” in Adhan & reminders.
strings.whatsnew_153_adhan_volume_body: Choose how loud the adhan plays, anywhere from 10% to full, in Adhan & reminders. Your phone's alarm volume isn't touched.
strings.whatsnew_153_adhan_volume_title: The adhan gets its own volume
strings.whatsnew_153_shamarly_body: The Shamarly print from Egypt is in Siraj now: fifteen lines to a page, and each surah's name in a frame of its own. Pick it under “Mushaf & reading” in Settings. You can go back to your old Mushaf whenever you like.
strings.whatsnew_154_fix_autoflip: Switching off “Turn pages automatically” keeps the page where you left it while the reciter carries on. Before, the page turned anyway.
strings.whatsnew_154_fix_qibla: Opening Qibla with location off no longer flashes the searching screen before asking you to turn it on.
strings.whatsnew_154_fix_reader_player: With Liquid Glass on, the player bar under a Mushaf page no longer shows odd coloured streaks.
strings.whatsnew_154_guide_body: “How to use Siraj” in Settings now covers the reciters' library: finding a reciter, saving surahs to hear offline, and the player's speed and sleep timer. The app tour stops at Settings and the reciters now, too.
strings.whatsnew_154_player_body: With a live background on, you'll see more of it through the full-screen player.
strings.whatsnew_154_player_title: The full player shows more of your scene
strings.whatsnew_154_runon_body: With ayah highlighting off, most reciters go from one ayah straight into the next, without the little wait in between. Highlighting keeps that pause so it can follow along, and switching it on tells you so.
strings.whatsnew_154_smooth_body: There used to be a brief stutter. Now the old look simply fades out, and changing colours, Liquid Glass or the live background works the same way.
strings.whatsnew_154_system_body: On Android 12 and newer, Siraj can take its colours from your wallpaper, the way the rest of your phone does. In Appearance, tap “Follow system colors” under Accent Palettes.
strings.whatsnew_154_widgets_body: Calligraphy date writes the day of the week large in Arabic, with today's Hijri and Gregorian dates under it. Verse card sets the verse of the day in a frame with roses in the corners. And the Hijri month widget now draws its month's name out a little, the way a calligrapher would.
strings.whatsnew_160_adhans_body: More choices to pick from, including Al-Husary, Mustafa Ismail and Sheikh Naji Qazzaz of Al-Aqsa.
strings.whatsnew_160_adhkar_meaning_body: Every dua in Adhkar now includes its translation and the hadith it comes from.
strings.whatsnew_160_ayah_view_body: More breathing room around each verse, controls within reach and a clearer highlight on the verse playing.
strings.whatsnew_160_colours_body: Find them alongside the other palettes in Settings.
strings.whatsnew_160_colours_title: Two new colours: Lime and Gold
strings.whatsnew_160_fajr_body: Fajr adhans now include “As-salatu khayrun min an-nawm”. Pick your preferred Fajr voice in Settings, or turn it off.
strings.whatsnew_160_fix_countdown: The countdown notification now shows the next prayer's clock time beside its name.
strings.whatsnew_160_fix_large_text: Tab labels and titles no longer clip when using large text sizes.
strings.whatsnew_160_fix_overlap: Fixed overlapping words in the ayah-by-ayah view.
strings.whatsnew_160_fix_qatami: Fixed a mismatch where certain adhans played the wrong recording.
strings.whatsnew_160_fix_radio_notification: Pause and resume Quran radio directly from the notification shade or lock screen.
strings.whatsnew_160_fix_zoom: Resting two fingers on a Mushaf page no longer triggers accidental zoom.
strings.whatsnew_160_hadith_body: Added authentic hadith on prayer, family, patience and daily life, each paired with its source reference.
strings.whatsnew_160_indopak_body: Read the Quran in the 15-line IndoPak script alongside the Madinah Mushaf, and switch between them any time in Quran settings.
strings.whatsnew_160_instant_body: Tap a surah and it appears immediately with no waiting screen.
strings.whatsnew_160_iqama_body: The adhan notification now shows when the iqama starts so you know how long you have before prayer begins.
strings.whatsnew_160_library_body: Stream from 38 reciters right away or download surahs to listen offline, including a selection of rare classic recordings.
strings.whatsnew_160_names_body: A new Name each day with its meaning, pronunciation and a brief note.
strings.whatsnew_160_new_widgets_body: Suhoor and iftar countdowns, a widget that picks up where you stopped reading, adjustable font sizing and fresh clock faces.
strings.whatsnew_160_player_body: Displays the reciter, the current ayah and playback progress. Swipe it aside when you are finished.
strings.whatsnew_160_radio_player_body: Tap the radio bar to open the full player, switch stations, pin favourites or set a sleep timer.
strings.whatsnew_160_ruqyah_body: Healing verses and prophetic duas now sit in their own chapter, alongside new sections for family, seeking knowledge and Laylat al-Qadr.
strings.whatsnew_160_settings_body: Grouped into clearer sections that preview your active choices at a glance.
strings.whatsnew_160_tafsir_body: The ayah stays pinned at the top while you read, and you can step to the next one without closing tafsir.
strings.whatsnew_intro: Here's what changed since the version you had.
